We are seeking an experienced Senior SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA) with 5 to 12 years of expertise in managing mission-critical database environments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, and security of SQL Server databases while supporting enterprise applications and business operations. This role requires strong hands-on experience in SQL Server administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, database security, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will collaborate with development, infrastructure, and operations teams to implement reliable and optimized database solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.

* **Role: Senior SQL Server Database Administrator (DBA)**

* Advanced proficiency in T-SQL, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, and Views.
* Strong understanding of relational database concepts, normalization, and database design principles.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server Performance Tuning and Optimization.
* Expertise in analyzing execution plans, indexing strategies, query optimization, and database performance monitoring.
* Strong experience implementing Backup, Restore, Disaster Recovery, and Business Continuity solutions.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and Failover Clustering.
* Experience with SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) and database monitoring tools.
* Strong understanding of database security, access management, auditing, and compliance practices.
* Experience managing production incidents and performing root cause analysis.
* Knowledge of database patching, upgrades, migrations, and environment management.
* Experience with Capacity Planning, Database Health Checks, and Performance Monitoring.

title: Database Administrator
description:
Welcome to Natus Sensory India
  
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
Position Summary
  
Senior Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator is responsible for the performance, availability, security, recoverability, and operational health of enterprise database platforms. This is a hands-on senior role combining system DBA responsibilities with advanced SQL performance engineering. The DBA will identify slow and inefficient workloads, analyze execution plans and wait conditions, rewrite complex queries and stored code, tune indexing and configuration, and verify measurable improvements without compromising data integrity or application behaviour.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Administer, configure, patch, upgrade, monitor, secure, and troubleshoot production and non-production Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Review database and instance configuration, memory, CPU, storage, I/O, parallelism, TempDB or temporary tablespaces, optimizer settings, statistics, and maintenance strategies.
* Proactively identify slow, high-cost, blocking, frequently executed, or resource-intensive SQL using platform telemetry and workload history.
* Analyze Oracle execution plans, AWR/ASH reports, SQL Monitor, wait events, session activity, and optimizer behaviour; use SQL Tuning Advisor appropriately and validate recommendations.
* Analyze SQL Server actual execution plans, Query Store, Extended Events, DMVs, wait statistics, blocking, deadlocks, memory grants, spills, parameter sensitivity, and plan regressions.
* Review and rewrite SQL, PL/SQL, T-SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, jobs, and batch processes to improve performance, scalability, maintainability, and correctness.
* Design and tune indexes, statistics, partitioning, query patterns, hints only when justified, and data-access strategies while controlling write, storage, and maintenance overhead.
* Establish repeatable performance baselines; document findings; test changes with representative data and workloads; compare duration, CPU, logical/physical I/O, waits, reads, plans, and concurrency before release.
* Own backup, restore, recovery, high availability, disaster recovery, replication, integrity checks, capacity planning, and recovery testing for both platforms.
* Support Oracle Data Guard/RMAN and SQL Server Always On, log shipping, Database Mail, SQL Agent, and native backup/restore technologies as applicable.
* Investigate incidents, blocking, deadlocks, failed jobs, corruption alerts, storage growth, capacity constraints, and database availability issues; complete root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Implement database security, encryption, auditing, least privilege, service-account controls, privileged-access practices, and compliant handling of PHI/PII.
* Automate repeatable DBA tasks using PowerShell, T-SQL, PL/SQL, SQL\*Plus/SQLcl, shell scripting, and source-controlled deployment processes.
* Partner with developers, architects, infrastructure, security, support, and vendors; provide code-review guidance and mentor other DBAs and engineers.

Required Qualifications
  

* Senior-level production DBA experience supporting both Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server in business-critical environments. Senior Oracle & SQL Server DBA
* Confidential recruiting document JOB REQUISITION | DATABASE ENGINEERING
* Expert-level SQL performance tuning and proven ability to review, rewrite, and optimize complex Oracle SQL/PL/SQL and SQL Server T-SQL.
* Deep understanding of cost-based optimization, cardinality estimation, join strategies, access paths, statistics, indexing, parameterization/bind variables, plan stability, and concurrency.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle AWR, ASH, execution plans, wait events, RMAN, Data Pump, Data Guard, and diagnostic or tuning tools.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server Query Store, execution plans, DMVs, Extended Events, wait statistics, indexing, SQL Agent, backup/restore, and Always On or log shipping.
* Strong knowledge of database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, migrations, security, backup/recovery, HA/DR, monitoring, and capacity planning.
* Ability to distinguish query, schema, statistics, configuration, infrastructure, locking, application, and data volume causes of poor performance.
* Experience tuning without relying on unverified hints or indiscriminate indexing, and ability to explain the risks and tradeoffs of each recommendation.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, change-management, communication, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Eight or more years of database administration and performance-engineering experience across Oracle and SQL Server.
* Oracle Certified Professional and/or relevant Microsoft database or Azure certification.
* Experience with SQL Server 2025 and supported standard Oracle releases, including hybrid or Azure-hosted workloads.
* Experience with Azure SQL, Managed Instance, Oracle on Azure, Linux, Windows Server, SAN/storage performance, and virtualization.
* Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT, CDC, replication, large databases, partitioning, bulk loads, and high-throughput transactional systems.
* Experience in regulated healthcare or another environment subject to HIPAA, SOC 2, PHI/PII, audit, and formal change-control requirements.

**Compensation and Benefits:** Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense.
  
  
**We offer:**  

* The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore.
* Minimal travelling: less than 5%
* Collaborative and international environment with different cultures.
* English company language.
* Full ownership of testing of features and functionality.

EEO Statement

title: Senior Product Support Engineer
description:
**Senior Product Support Engineer**
Development \+ Technical Support**Experience:** 5–7 years**Function:** Product Engineering / Customer Success**Employment type:** Full\-time**Location:** \[Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote]**Reports to:** \[Manager, Technical Support / Head of Engineering]**About the role**
==================


This is a hybrid engineering and support role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a customer’s production issue and writing the code that stops it happening again.
You will be the senior technical escalation point for our product across heterogeneous customer environments Windows, Linux and Solaris, integrated with enterprise Active Directory, SIEM platforms and a range of network infrastructure. Roughly half your time will be spent on deep troubleshooting and customer\-facing escalation; the other half on building fixes, tooling, integrations and automation that reduce future ticket volume.
We are looking for someone who treats a recurring support ticket as a defect to be engineered away, not a queue to be worked through.**What you will do**
====================

**Troubleshooting and escalation**
----------------------------------

* Own Level 3 escalations end to endreproduce, diagnose root cause, and drive to resolution across OS, network, database and application layers
* Analyse logs, packet captures, stack traces, core dumps and performance counters to isolate faults in complex multi\-vendor environments
* Diagnose issues spanning customer infrastructure boundaries: authentication, directory services, firewalls, proxies, certificates and network policy
* Work directly with customer IT, security and infrastructure teams, including during high\-severity incidents
* Produce clear root cause analysis documents for customer and internal audiences

**Development**
---------------

* Build and ship fixes, patches and product improvements in C\# and Python
* Develop diagnostic tooling, log analysers, health\-check scripts and automated reproduction harnesses
* Write and optimise SQL for investigation, data correction and performance analysis
* Build and maintain customer\-facing integrationsActive Directory, SIEM connectors, APIs and data pipelines
* Contribute to product hardening: instrumentation, logging quality, error handling and observability

**Deployment and integration**
------------------------------

* Support installation, upgrade and configuration of the product across Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Solaris
* Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory / LDAP integration, Kerberos, SSO and certificate\-based authentication
* Integrate product telemetry and event data with customer SIEM platforms
* Support cloud and hybrid deployments, including containerised environments

**Knowledge and enablement**
----------------------------

* Maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides
* Mentor junior support engineers and act as a technical reviewer on complex tickets
* Feed recurring issues and field insight back into the product roadmap

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

**Experience**
--------------

* 5–7 years in a combined engineering and technical support capacity, supporting an enterprise software product deployed in customer environments
* Demonstrable history of resolving complex, cross\-system production issues

**Operating systems**
---------------------

* Strong administration and troubleshooting on Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) systemd, journald, permissions, process and resource analysis, package management
* Windows Server administration — services, Event Viewer, registry, PowerShell, IIS, performance monitoring
* Working knowledge of Solaris or another commercial UNIX in a legacy enterprise context
* Shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell)

**Identity and security**
-------------------------

* Hands\-on Active Directory integration: LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, group policy, service accounts, delegation, trusts
* Experience integrating applications with SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent) — log forwarding, syslog, CEF/LEEF, event normalisation
* Practical understanding of TLS/PKI, certificate management and common certificate failure modes

**Networking**
--------------

* Solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancers and proxies
* Ability to read and interpret packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to isolate connectivity and latency issues

**Development**
---------------

* Proficient in C\# / .NET
* Proficient in Python for automation, tooling and data processing
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read unfamiliar production code and trace a fault to its source

**Database**
------------

* Strong SQL against at least one of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL
* Query performance analysis, indexing, execution plans, backup/restore, and basic administration

**Cloud**
---------

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) — compute, networking, identity, storage and managed database services
* Familiarity with containerised deployment (Docker; Kubernetes an advantage)
* Understanding of hybrid architectures where product components span on\-premises and cloud

**Desirable**
=============

* Experience with email infrastructure and protocolsIMAP, SMTP, Exchange/EWS, Microsoft Graph
* Exposure to machine learning or classification systems in a production support context
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and observability tooling (Grafana, ELK, Prometheus)
* Certifications: RHCE/RHCSA, Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Security\+
* Experience supporting regulated customers — financial services, healthcare or public sector
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management

**What we look for beyond the checklist**
=========================================

* **Structured diagnostic thinking.** You form hypotheses and test them rather than changing settings until something works.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** Enterprise environments are undocumented and inconsistent; you find your own way in.
* **Customer\-grade communication.** You can explain a Kerberos delegation failure to a CISO and to a junior admin, correctly, in the same afternoon.
* **Composure under pressure.** You are calm and credible on a Severity 1 bridge call.
* **A bias toward permanent fixes.** You are more interested in the third occurrence never happening than in closing the ticket quickly.
